lines.en: Hello? This is an emergency.
Please stay calm. What happened?
There is a small fire in my kitchen.
Is any person in danger?
No. My grandson and I escaped a minute ago.
lines.ko: 아니요. 손주와 저는 조금 전에 빠져나왔어요.

lines.en: Good. Please wait outside. Help will arrive in five minutes.
lines.ko: 잘하셨어요. 밖에서 기다리세요. 오 분 후에 도움이 도착할 거예요.

lines.en: Thank you. Should I shout for the neighbors?
Yes. Give them a warning and protect the children.
Okay. I closed the kitchen door before I left.
lines.ko: 알겠어요. 나오기 전에 부엌 문을 닫았어요.

lines.en: Well done. The fire team will be there soon.
Excuse me, Sir. Why is this road closed?
lines.ko: 실례해요. 이 도로는 왜 막혀 있어요?

lines.en: It's dangerous. A tree fell this morning.
Oh no. Was everyone safe?
Yes. Everyone is safe now.
Good. I walk this way every day.
lines.ko: 다행이에요. 저는 매일 이 길로 걸어요.

lines.en: Please use the other street until tomorrow.
I will. Is this a warning sign?
Yes. In an emergency, call the police quickly.
lines.ko: 네. 응급 상황에는 경찰에 빨리 전화하세요.

lines.en: Thank you for protecting our village.
It's our job. We will fix the road tomorrow.
lines.ko: 저희 일이에요. 내일 도로를 고칠 거예요.
